page.overview:
Who is Doyle Jeffries?

Doyle Jeffries is a fictional character who appears in Fantasy Flight Games' Arkham Horror Files line of Cthulhu Mythos-related games and fiction. He is the editor of the Arkham Advertiser, Arkham's local newspaper in the Fantasy Flight Games version of the Cthulhu Mythos.

Doyle Jeffries first appeared in the Arkham Horror Second Edition expansion The King in Yellow as a Blight, a character which imparts negative effects onto the players.

In Richard Lee Byers' 2018 novella Ire of the Void, Professor Norman Withers approached Jeffries at the offices of the Advertiser requesting access to their archives in an effort to find others which had suffered the same fate as his friend Claus Schmidt, who had been abducted by a Hound of Tindalos. Jeffries obliged this request, on the condition that Withers later give him an exclusive interview on the event. Jeffries did indeed get his exclusive, but it was a heavily-edited version of the tale which featured no supernatural events.
